current_prompt.body:
FIND all exact covers of the universe U = {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9} using the collection of sets S1…S9.
IMPLEMENT the search with Knuth's Algorithm X employing dancing links.
PROVIDE a self‑contained test that checks each reported solution covers every element of U exactly once and no element appears in more than one selected set.

current_plan.body:
PARSE the definition of universe U and the collection of sets S1…S9
CONSTRUCT a dancing‑links structure representing the exact‑cover matrix
EXECUTE Knuth's Algorithm X to enumerate every exact cover
FOR EACH generated solution
VALIDATE that the solution covers every element of U exactly once and that no element appears in more than one selected set
OUTPUT all validated solutions together with a self‑contained test that performs the validation
